request-prompt: Add a 'Discover New Channels' filter button next to the existing 'Filters' button in the search header to actively promote and recommend smaller, new creators I haven't watched.
goal: I love exploring and discovering new creators through search results and algorithmic recommendations.
jobs: I want to watch funny or cute cat compilations to improve my mood.
I want to browse and watch short, vertical cat videos (Shorts) for quick entertainment.
I want to filter the cat video results by criteria like 'Unwatched' or 'Recently uploaded' to discover fresh content.
I want to find a live cat stream to see live feline activities in real-time.
I want to search for a more specific cat topic using the search box if the general results aren't what I need.
I want to sign in to my YouTube account to save interesting cat videos to my library or subscribe to the channels.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer short-form, bite-sized vertical video content (like Shorts) for quick bursts of entertainment throughout my day.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer long-form, horizontal videos and compilations that I can lean back and watch on a larger screen.

preference-pairs.a: I love exploring and discovering new creators through search results and algorithmic recommendations.
preference-pairs.b: I only watch videos from channels and creators I already know and trust, rarely clicking on unfamiliar recommendations.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer to use video platforms while logged into an account so I can customize my feed, like, comment, and build a search history.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer to watch content completely anonymously and passively, avoiding signing in or leaving any digital footprint on the platform.

preference: I love exploring and discovering new creators through search results and algorithmic recommendations.
